purpose: Illustrative manual prompts for the 1.3 skill expansion; not a benchmark dataset, runner, or reliability score.

scenarios.prompt: Inspect a supplied Next.js/FastAPI/PostgreSQL sketch and plan owner-only project invitations accepted once by the invited user. Do not implement or run services. Cite the existing files, separate undecided expiry/provider/member rules, and return a bounded design and ordered plan with acceptance checks.
observe: no implementation or claimed runtime pass

scenarios.prompt: Review supplied login code and tests read-only. Success may redirect only to a same-origin path; failure stays on the form with an accessible error. No browser, app, screenshots, accounts, or interaction permission is available. Separate source findings and missing coverage from unrun runtime/browser checks.

Fix a disposable label helper to trim/lowercase strings, preserve internal spaces, and reject empty/whitespace strings. Run the existing tests before edits. Only the helper may change. Use at most two repairs, recheck each, and report actual commands/results, attempt count, patch state, and unresolved limits. Non-strings are out of scope.
